$1 Billion for a perfect bracket

$1 Million for the highest scoring bracket if no perfect bracket is submitted

$1 Million to charity and scholarships

By creating a bracket, you agree to the Official Rules and Kalshi terms, which include a binding arbitration agreement and class action waiver.

A Nevada court has issued a temporary restraining order affecting certain markets on Kalshi. **We strongly disagree, and are fighting this decision.** As a CFTC-regulated exchange, we believe state regulators cannot override our federal framework.

american_odds_cta_content.title: Price display update
american_odds_cta_content.primary_message:
We're writing to give you an update on a change to how prices are displayed on Kalshi.

On August 7, the CFTC — the federal agency that regulates Kalshi — issued guidance stating that regulated exchanges should not display pricing in the American odds format. In line with that guidance, we will be removing American odds from the Kalshi App on Aug 31. Going forward, prices can be viewed in cents, %, or multiplier formats.

To be clear: Nothing about the markets themselves is changing. Contract prices, order books, payouts, and your positions all work exactly as they do today. This change only affects how prices are shown on screen.
american_odds_cta_content.secondary_message:
We understand that this update means a change from the American odds format some of you prefer. As a CFTC-regulated exchange, we follow our regulator’s guidance — which is what lets us offer these markets legally.

Thanks for trading with us!
